basics.name: Syed Muhammad Ali Naqvi
basics.label: AI & Robotics Engineer
basics.summary: AI and Robotics Engineer working on embodied AI, autonomous mobile robots, and perception. Background in Computer Science with minors in Electrical & Computer Engineering and Mathematics. Interested in merging classical control with modern data-driven foundation models.

work.name: Farmevo Technologies
work.summary: Leading the software stack for a quadruped-based autonomous sensing platform for forestry.
highlights: Real-time navigation, localization, and multimodal perception on a legged platform.
LiDAR-camera 3D reconstruction and tree segmentation for forest inventory and carbon stock estimation.

work.name: Covolv.ai
work.summary: Built and deployed ML-based perception for L2+ autonomous driving products.
highlights: Real-time multi-camera BEV perception pipeline in ROS 2, 6 streams at 25 FPS on embedded hardware.
Offloaded inference from GPU to a dedicated AI accelerator for an 87% end-to-end speedup.

work.name: Habib University
work.summary: Computational pipeline for CRISPR-Cas13b guide RNA design against Dengue virus.
highlights: Published at BICOB 2026; ML-ranked crRNA candidates across all four serotypes.

work.name: Texas A&M University
work.summary: Spectral calibration for Swept-Source Optical Coherence Tomography at the Mixed Signals Lab.
highlights: Deep learning calibration pipeline using LSTMs, reducing calibration error to 12%.
